[[Nuwisha]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The spirits are angry. Those blasted [[harpy|skree harpies]] have been tearing up sacred sites and using the materials for their nests. The only way to pacify the spirits is to seek vengeance on the those foul birds, but I'll admit... they're a bit much for me to handle. Care to lend a hand? If you can bring me 5 [[Skree Wing]]s to help ease the spirits, I'll gladly give you:"''

{{:Nuwisha/Collector}}

==Notes==
*She does not spawn if you have the quest [[Guard Rescue]] active.

==Trivia==
*Nuwisha is the name given to the Werecoyotes in [http://www.white-wolf.com/ White Wolf, Inc.]'s ''Werewolf: the Apocalypse'' game system.
